[अविवेषीः, iv, 22, 5 &c.]; aor. अविक्षत्, अविक्षत, Gr.; Impv. विड्ढि, AV.; fut. वेक्ष्यति, ˚ते, Br.; वेष्टा Gr.; inf. वेष्टुम् Gr.; -विषे, RV.; ind.p. विष्ट्वी, ib.; -विष्य, AV.), to be active, act, work, do, perform, RV.; ŚBr.; (cl. 1. P. वेषति cf. Dhātup. xvii, 47) to be quick, speed, run, flow (as water), ib.; to work as a servant, serve, ib.; to have done with i.e. overcome, subdue, rule, ib.; (Naigh. ii, 8) to be contained in (acc.), Tattvak. : Caus. वेषयति, to clothe, BhP. : Intens. (or cl. 3. accord. to Dhātup. xxv, 13) वेवेष्टि, वेविष्टे, to be active or busy in various ways &c., RV.; AV.; (p. वेविषत्) to consume, eat, ib. (cf. Naigh. ii, 8); (p. वेविषाण) aided or supported by (instr.), RV. vii, 18, 15.
2. विष् mfn. consuming (cf. जरद्-विष्)
= व्यापन, pervasion, L.
3. विष् f. (nom. विट्) feces, ordure, excrement, impure excretion, dirt, Mn.; Yājñ.; VarBṛS. &c.
4. विष् cl. 9. P. विष्णाति, to separate, disjoin, Dhātup. xxxi, 54.
a: विष् — {vI.v} {c3c} U. (वेवेष्टि, वेविष्टे, --विष्ट) 1 To surround. --2 To spread through, extend, pervade. --3 To embrace. --4 To accomplish, effect, perform. --5 To eat. --6 To go to, go against, encounter; (not generally used in classical literature). {vII.v} {c9c} P. ( विष्णाति) To separate, disjoin. {vIII.v} {c1c} P. (वेषति) To sprinkle, pour out.

विष् — f. 1 Feces, excrement, ordure. --2 Spreading, diffusion. --3 A girl, as in विट्पति. --Comp. --कारिका (विट्कारिका) a kind of bird. --ग्रहः (विड्ग्रहः) constipation. --चरः, --वराहः (विट्चरः, विड्वराहः) a tame or village hog (eating ordure). --पतिः a son-in-law. --लवणं (विड्लवणं) a kind of medicinal salt. --संगः ( विट्संगः) constipation. --सारिका ( विट्सारिका) a kind of bird.

m: विष्णु m. (prob. fr. √ विष्, ‘All-pervader’ or ‘Worker’) N. of one of the principal Hindū deities (in the later mythology regarded as ‘the preserver’, and with Brahmā ‘the creator’ and Śiva ‘the destroyer’, constituting the well-known Tri-mūrti or triad; although Viṣṇu comes second in the triad he is identified with the supreme deity by his worshippers; in the Vedic period, however, he is not placed in the foremost rank, although he is frequently invoked with other gods [esp. with Indra whom he assists in killing Vṛtra and with whom he drinks the Soma juice; cf. his later names Indrānuja and Upendra]; as distinguished from the other Vedic deities, he is a personification of the light and of the sun, esp. in his striding over the heavens, which he is said to do in three paces [see त्रि-विक्रम and cf. बलि, वामन], explained as denoting the threefold manifestations of light in the form of fire, lightning, and the sun, or as designating the three daily stations of the sun in his rising, culminating, and setting ; Viṣṇu does not appear to have been included at first among the Ādityas [q.v.], although in later times he is accorded the foremost place among them; in the Brāhmaṇas he is identified with sacrifice, and in one described as a dwarf; in the Mahā-bhārata and Rāmāyaṇa he rises to the supremacy which in some places he now enjoys as the most popular deity of modern Hindū worship; the great rivalry between him and Śiva [cf. वैष्णव and शैव] is not fully developed till the period of the Purāṇas: the distinguishing feature in the character of the Post-vedic Viṣṇu is his condescending to become incarnate in a portion of his essence on ten principal occasions, to deliver mankind from certain great dangers [cf. अवतार and IW. 327]; some of the Purāṇas make 22 incarnations, or even 24, instead of 10; the Vaiṣṇavas regard Viṣṇu as the supreme being, and often identify him with Nārāyaṇa, the personified Puruṣa or primeval living spirit [described as moving on the waters, reclining on Śeṣa, the serpent of infinity, while the god Brahmā emerges from a lotus growing from his navel; cf. Manu. i, 10]; the wives of Viṣṇu are Aditi and Sinīvālī, later Lakṣmī or Śrī and even Sarasvatī; his son is Kāma-deva, god of love, and his paradise is called Vaikuṇṭha; he is usually represented with a peculiar mark on his breast called Śrī-vatsa, and as holding a शङ्ख, or conch-shell called Pāñcajanya, a चक्र or quoit-like missile-weapon called Su-darśana, a गदा or club called Kaumodakī and a पद्म or lotus; he has also a bow called Śārṅga, and a sword called Nandaka; his वाहन or vehicle is Garuḍa q.v.; he has a jewel on his wrist called Syamantaka, another on his breast called Kaustubha, and the river Ganges is said to issue from his foot; the demons slain by him in his character of ‘preserver from evil’, or by Kṛṣṇa as identified with him, are Madhu, Dhenuka, Cāṇūra, Yamala, and Arjuna [see यमलार्जुन], Kāla-nemi, Haya-grīva, Śakaṭa, Ariṣṭa, Kaiṭabha, Kaṃsa, Keśin, Mura, Śālva, Mainda, Dvi-vida, Rāhu, Hiraṇya-kaśipu, Bāṇa, Kāliya, Naraka, Bali; he is worshipped under a thousand names, which are all enumerated in MBh. xiii, 6950-7056; he is sometimes regarded as the divinity of the lunar mansion called Śravaṇa), RV. &c. &c. (cf. RTL. 44; IW. 324)

a: विष्णुः — [विष् व्यापने नुक् Uṇ. 3. 39] 1 The second deity of the sacred Triad, entrusted with the preservation of the world, which duty he is represented to have duly discharged by his various incarnations; (for their descriptions see the several avatāras s. v. and also under अवतार); the word is thus popularly derived: --यस्माद्विश्वमिदं सर्वं तस्य शक्त्या महात्मनः . तस्मादेवोच्यते विष्णुर्वीशधातोः प्रवेशनात् ... --2 N. of Agni. --3 A pious man. --4 N. of a law-giver, author of a Smṛti called विष्णुस्मृति. --5 N. of one of the Vasus. --6 The lunar mansion called Śravaṇa (presided over by Viṣṇu). --Comp. --कांची N. of a town. --क्रमः the step or stride of Viṣṇu. --गुप्तः N. of Cāṇakya. --तैलं a kind of medicinal oil. --दैवत्या N. of the eleventh and twelfth days of each fortnight (of a lunar month). --पदं {1} the sky, atmosphere. {2} the sea of milk. {3} the foot of Viṣṇu (worshipped at Gayā). {4} a lotus. --पदी an epithet of the Ganges. --पुराणं N. of one of the most celebrated of the eighteen Purāṇas. --प्रीतिः f. land granted rent-free to Brāhmaṇas to maintain Viṣṇu's worship. --माया N. of Durgā. --रथः an epithet of Garuḍa. --रातः N. of king Parīkṣit. --लिंगी a quail. --लोकः Viṣṇu's world. --वल्लभा {1} an epithet of Lakṣmī. {2} the holy basil. --वाहनः, --वाह्यः epithets of Garuḍa.

a: विषं — [विष्-क] 1 Poison, venom (said to be m. also in this sense); विषं भवतु मा भूद्वा फटाटोपो भयंकरः Pt. 1. 204. --2 Water; विषं जलधरैः पीतं मूर्छिताः पथिकांगनाः Chandr. 5. 82 (where both senses are intended). --3 The fibres of a lotus-stalk. --4 Gummyrrh. --Comp. --अक्त, --दिग्ध a. poisoned, envenomed. --अंकुरः {1} a spear. {2} a poisoned arrow. --अंतक a. antidotal. --(कः) an epithet of Śiva. --अपह, --घ्न a. repelling poison, antidotal. --आननः, --आयुधः, --आस्यः a snake. --आस्या the marking-nut plant. --आस्वाद a. tasting poison. --कंठः N. of Śiva. --कुंभः a jar filled with poison. --कृमिः a worm bred in poison. ˚न्याय see under न्याय. --घातिन् m. the Śirīṣa tree. --घ्न a. antidotal, serving as an antidote; इति चिंताविषघ्नोयमगदः किं न पीयते H. 1. --(घ्नः) {1} an antidote. {2} the शिरीष and चंपक trees. --(घ्नी) {1} turmeric. {2} colocynth. --जुष्ट a. {1} poisonous. {2} poisoned, affected by poison. --ज्वरः a buffalo. --दः a cloud. --(दं) green vitriol. --दंतकः a snake. --दर्शनमृत्युकः, --मृत्युः a kind of bird (said to be Cakora). --द्रुमः = ˚वृक्ष. q. v. --धरः a snake; Bv. 1. 74. ˚निलयः the lower regions, the abode of snakes. --पुष्पं the blue lotus. --पुष्पकः a disease caused by eating poisonous flowers. --प्रयोगः use of poison, administering poison. --भिषज् m., --वैद्यः a dealer in antidotes, a curer of snake-bites; संप्रति विषवैद्यानां कर्म M. 4. --मंत्रः {1} a spell for curing snake-bites, {2} a snakecharmer, conjurer. --रसः a poisoned potion, poison-liquid; U. 2. 26. --विद्या cure of poison. --वृक्षः, --द्रुमः a poisonous tree; विषवृक्षोपि संवर्ध्य स्वयं छेत्तुमसांप्रतं Ku. 2. 55; श्रिनासि चंदनभ्रांत्या दुर्विपाकं विषद्रुमं U. 1. 46. ˚न्याय see under न्याय. --वेगः the circulation or effect of poison. --शालूकः the root of the lotus. --शूकः, --शृंगिन्, --सृक्कन् m. a wasp. --सूचकः the Cakora bird. --हृदय a. ‘poisonhearted’, malicious.

वि-षण्ण—चेतस् mfn. dejected in mind, low-spirited, downcast, R.
वि-षण्ण—मनस् mfn. = -चेतस्, BhP.
वि-षण्ण—मुख mf(ई)n. dejected in countenance, looking sad or dejected, R.
वि-षण्ण—रूप mf(आ)n. having a sorrowful aspect, being in a dejected mood, R.

s: strI, (vizaRRasya BAvaH । tal .) jaqatA । yaTA, -- “jAqyaM mOrKyaM vizAdo'vasAdaH sAdo vizaRRatA ॥” iti hemacandraH ॥
m: वि-षण्ण—ता f. dejection, sadness, languor, lassitude (esp. as one of the effects of unsuccessful love), L.
वि-षण्ण—त्व n. dejection, sadness, languor, lassitude (esp. as one of the effects of unsuccessful love), L.
वि-षण्ण—वदन mfn. = -मुख, ib.
विषणि m. a kind of snake, L.
विषण्ड n. = मृणाल, the fibres of the stalk of the water-lily, L.

s: puM, (vizasya SAlUkaH .) padmakandaH । asya guRAH । gurutvam । vizwamBitvam । SItalatvaYca । iti rAjavallaBaH ॥
v: pu॰ vizasya laRAlasya SAlUkaH । padmakande rAjani॰ ।
m: विष—शालूक See बिस-श्˚.

s: puM, (vizaM SUke yasya .) BfNgarolaH । iti BUriprayogaH ॥
m: विष—शूक (Suśr.) or विष—शृङ्गिन् (L.), m. ‘having a poisonous sting’, a wasp.

s: [n] puM, (vizaM vizayuktaM SfNgaM tadasyAstIti । vizaSfNga + iniH .) BfNgarolaH । iti hArAvalI ॥

v: pu॰ vizaM SfNgamivAstyasya ini । BfNgarole hArA॰ ।

m: वि-षञ्ज् (√ सञ्ज्) P. -षजति to hang on, hang to, attach, TS.; Kāṭh.; (-षज्जते), to be attached or devoted to, BhP. (pr. p. -षज्जत्, addicted to worldly objects, ib.; -षज्जन्ती f. devoted to a man, ib.); to be stuck to or clung to, i.e. be followed at the heels by (instr.), ib.

वि-षद् (√ सद्) P. -षीदति (impf. Class. व्य्-अषीदत्, Ved. व्य-षीदत्, or व्य्-असीदत्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 119; pf. वि-षसाद, ib. 118; inf. -षत्तुम् or -षीदितुम्, MBh.), to be exhausted or dejected, despond, despair, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to sink down, be immersed in (loc.), R. v, 95, 15 (perhaps वि-षेदुः w.r. for नि-ष्˚) : Caus. -षादयति, to cause to despond or despair, vex, grieve, afflict, MBh.; B. &c.
a: विषद् — {c1c} P. 1 To sink down, be exhausted. --2 To be dispirited or cast down, be afflicted or sorrowful, despond, despair; विलपति हसति विषीदति रोदिति चंचति मुंचति तापं Gīt. 4; बालसूनुरवलोक्य भार्गवं स्वां दशां च विषसाद पर्थिवः R. 11. 67; Bg. 2. 1; Bk. 7. 89; R. 9. 75. --3 To be afraid. --Caus. 1 To cause to despond or despair, discourage. --2 To make afflicted, pain.

m: विष—दायक, mf(इका)n. or विष—दायिन्, mfn. giving p˚, poisoning, a poisoner, Kām.; R.
विष—दूषण mf(ई)n. destroying p˚, AV.
विष—दूषण n. corrupting by admixture of p˚, poisoning (of food), Kām.

s: klI, (vizaM dadAtIti । dA + kaH .) puzpakAsIsam । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ SuklavarRe, puM । ityamarawIkA ॥ (nirmmale prasanne ca tri । yaTA, raGuH । 10 । 14 । “yoganidrAntavizadEH pAvanEravalokanEH ॥”)
v: na॰ vi + zada--ac । 1 puzpakAsIse rAjani॰ । 2 Sukla-
m: विष—द mfn. yielding p˚, poisonous, W.
विष—द m. ‘shedding water’, a cloud, Śiś.
विष—द n. green vitriol, W.

s: strI, (vizaM daMzwrAyAM yasyAH .) sarpakaNkAlI । iti ratnamAlA ॥
v: strI vizayuktA daMzwrA । 1 sarpadaMzwrAyAm । vizasya daMzwreva nASakatvAt । 2 sarpakaNkAlIlatAyAM ratnamA॰ ।
m: विष—दंष्ट्रा f. a medicinal plant and antidote (= सर्प-कङ्काली), L.
विष—दण्ड m. = विषापहार-दण्ड, Pañcad.

v: puMstrI॰ vizaM dante yasya kap । 1 sarpe Sabdaca॰ striyAM NIz ।
m: विष—दन्तक m. ‘having poisonous teeth’, a snake, L.

s: puM, (vizadarSane mftyuryasya । kan .) cakorapakzI । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: puMstrI॰ vizasya darSanena mftyurasya kap । cakoraKage hemaca॰ striyAM NIz ।
m: विष—दर्शन-मृत्युक m. ‘dying at the sight of p˚’, a kind of pheasant, L. (cf. विष-मृत्यु).
विष—दिग्ध mfn. smeared with p˚, empoisoned, poisoned, MBh.
विष—दोष-हर mfn. taking away the ill effects of p˚, MW.
विष—द्रुम m. a kind of p˚-tree, the Upas tree, Kāv.; Rājat.
विष—द्विषा f. a kind of Guḍūcī, L.
विष—गिरि m. ‘p˚-mountain’, a mountain producing p˚, AV.
विष—ग्रन्थि N. of a plant (?), MW.

वि-षह् (√ सह्) Ā. -षहते (impf. व्य्-अषहत, or व्य्-असहत, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 71; inf. -षहितुम् or -सोढुम्, not -षोढुम्, ib., 115), to conquer, subdue, overpower, be a match for (acc.), RV.; AV.; MBh.; Hariv.; to be able to or capable of (inf.), MBh.; R.; to bear, withstand, resist, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to endure, suffer, put up with (acc. also with inf.), R.; Gīt.; BhP. : Caus. (only aor. व्य्-असीष-हत्), Pāṇ. viii, 3, 116 : Intens. See वि-षासहि.
a: विषह् — {c1c} A. 1 To bear, suffer, endure; दुर्वारं सा कथमपि परित्यागदुःखं विषेहे R. 14. 87, 3. 63, 8. 57. --2 To resist, oppose, withstand, be able to resist; तस्यामेव रघोः पांड्याः प्रतापं न विषेहिरे R. 4. 49. --3 To be able; Śi. 14. 29, 17. 10. --4 To allow.

s: strI, (vizaha + wAp .) devadAlIlatA । nirvvAzA । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: strI vizaM hanti hana--qa । devadAlIlatAyAm rAjani॰ ।
m: विष—हा f. Kyllingia Monocephala, L.
a kind of gourd, L.
विष—हीन mfn. free from poison (as a serpent), ŚārṅgP.
विष—ह mfn. removing p˚, L.
विष—हन् mf(घ्नी)n. destroying poison
(-घ्नी चिकित्सा, the science of antidotes), Car.
विष—हन् m. a kind of Kadamba, L.
विष—हन्तृ mfn. destroying or counteracting p˚
विष—हन्तृ f. (त्री) N. of various plants (= अ-पराजिता or निर्-विषा), L.

s: strI, (viza + hana + tfc । striyAM NIz .) aparAjitA । nirvvizA । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: strI vizaM hanti hana--tfc NIp । 1 aparAjitAyAm rAjani॰ । 2 vizahArake tri॰ ।

strI, manasAdevI । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, devIBAgavate । 9 । 47 । 47 । “vizaM saMharttumISA yA tasmAdvizaharI smftA ॥”)
v: strI vizaM harati hf--ac gOrA॰ NIz । 1 manasAdevyAM Sabdaca॰ । 2 vidyABede tantrasA॰

s: tri, (haratIti । hf + ac । vizasya haraH .) garalanASakOzaDAdiH । yaTA । o~ hra~ jaH । “mantro'yaM harate rudra sarvvavfScikagaM vizam । pippalI navanItaYca SfNgaveraYca sEnDavam । marIcaM daDi kuzWaYca nasye pAne vizaM haret ॥ triPalA waNkakuzWaYca candanaM GftasaMyutam । etatpAnAcca lepAcca vizanASo BavecCiva ॥ pArAvatasya cAkzIRi haritAlaM manaHSilA । eza yogo vizaM hanti vEnateya ivoragAn ॥ sEnDavaM vyuzaRaM cUrRaM daDimaDvAjyasaMyutam । vfScikasya vizaM hanti lepo'yaM vfzaBaDvaja ॥” iti gAruqe 186 aDyAyaH ॥
m: विष—हर mf(आ or ई)n. removing venom, antidotal, MBh.
विष—हर m. N. of a son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, ib.
विष—हर f(आ or ई). the goddess who protects from the venom of snakes (see विष-धात्री, मनसा), L.
विष—हर—चिकित्सा f. N. of wk.
विष—हर—मन्त्रौषध n. N. of wk.
विष—हर—मन्त्र-प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
विष—हेति m. ‘whose weapon is poison’, a serpent, Harav.
विष—हृदय mfn. poison-hearted, cherishing hatred or hostility, malicious, malignant, Hit.
वि-षह्य mfn. bearable, tolerable (see अ-व्˚), conquerable, resistible, MBh.; R.
(also with कर्तुम्) possible, practicable, MBh.
ascertainable, determinable (see अ-व्˚).
a: विषह्य — a. 1 Endurable, bearable; अविषह्यव्यसनेन धूमितां Ku. 4. 30, R. 6. 47. --2 Possible to be settled or determined; Ms. 8. 265. --3 Possible.

m: विष—ज mfn. produced by p˚, MBh.
विष—जल n. poisoned water, BhP.

v: pu॰ vizayuktA jihveva patramasyAH । devatAqavfkze ratnamA॰ ।
m: विष—जिह्व (विष-), mfn. venom-tongued, ŚBr.
विष—जिह्व m. Lipeocercis Serrata, L.
विष—जित् n. ‘conquering or destroying p˚’, a kind of honey, L.
वि-षज्जित mfn. clinging or sticking or adhering to, BhP.
विष—जुष्ट mfn. possessed of poison, poisonous, W.
poisoned, Suśr.

s: puM, (vizavat prARanASako jvaro yasya .) mahizaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ vizajajvaraSca ॥
v: puMstrI॰ vizamiva prARahantA jvaro yasya । 1 mahize Sabdara॰ । striyAM NIz ।
m: विष—ज्वर m. a buffalo, L. (v.l. -त्वर).
विष—काष्ठ n. Thespesia Populnea, L.
विष—कण्ठ m. ‘poison-necked’, N. of Śiva, A. (cf. विषाग्नि-पा).

s: strI, (vizayuktaH kaRwako'syA astIti । iniH । NIz .) banDyAkarkowakI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (asyAH paryyAyo yaTA, -- “vanDyAkarkowakI devI kanyAyogISvarIti ca । nAgArinakradamanI vizakaRwakinI taTA ॥” iti BAvaprakASasya pUrvvaKaRqe praTame BAge ॥)
v: strI vizayuktaM kaRwakamastyasyA ini । banDyAkarkowyAm rAjani॰
m: विष—कण्टकिनी f. a kind of plant (= बन्ध्य-कर्कोटकी), L.

s: puM, (vizayuktaH kando yasya .) nIlakandaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
m: विष—कन्द m. a species of bulbous plant (= नील-कन्द), L.
विष—कन्यका or विष—कन्या, f. a girl supposed to cause the death of a man who has had intercourse with her, Mudr.; Kathās.
विष—कृमि m. ‘poison-worm’, a worm bred in poison, Cāṇ.
विष—कृमि—न्याय m. the rule of the poison-worm (denoting that what may be fatal to others, is not so to those who are bred in it), A.
विष—कृत mfn. poisoned, Kāv.
वि-षक्त mfn. hung to or on or upon, hung or suspended to, hanging or sticking on or in, firmly fixed or fastened or adhering to (loc.), AV. &c. &c.
turned or directed towards (loc. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
spread or extended over (loc.), Jātakam.
(ifc.) dependent on Daś.
produced, implanted, Uttarar.
stopped, interrupted (said of a cow that has ceased to give milk), RV. i, 117, 20
a: विषक्त — p. p. 1 Fixed firmly or closely. --2 Adhering or clinging closely to. --3 Hung or suspended on; Ś. 1. 32. --4 Caused, produced; U. 4. 3.

m: वि-षक्त—त्व n. the being occupied with (loc.), MBh.
विष—कुम्भ m. a jar of poison, Hit.
विष—लाङ्गल m. or n. a species of plant, Suśr.
विष—लाटा or विष—लाण्टा, f. N. of a place, Rājat.
विषल n. poison, venom, L.
a: विषलः — Poison, venom.

m: विष—लड्डुक mfn. poisoned, Vet.

s: strI, (vizasya latA .) indravAruRI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (vizapraDAnalatAmAtre । yaTA, gItAyAM SrIDaraH । 2 । 42 । “vizalatAvadApAtato ramaRIyAm ॥”)
v: strA viza--vyAptO ac karmma॰ । indravAruRyAm । rAjani॰
m: विष—लता f. ‘poisonous creeper’, the colocynth plant, L.
वि-ष˚माशन n. eating irregularly (either as to quantity or time), Vāgbh.; Siṃhās.; Bhpr.
वि-ष˚माशय mfn. having an unfair disposition, dishonest, crafty, W.
वि-ष˚मादित्य m. N. of a poet, Subh.

s: puM, (vizamaM ayugmaM akzi yasya । trinayanatvAdasya taTAtvam .) SivaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
m: वि-ष˚माक्ष m. ‘three-eyed’, N. of Śiva, Śivag.
वि-ष˚मान्न n. irregular or unusual food, MW.
वि-ष˚मार्थ-दीपिका f. N. of wk.
वि-ष˚मावतार m. descending on uneven ground, MW.
विषमाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to become or appear uneven, Cāṇ.

s: puM, (vizamA ayugmA AyuDA yasya । tasya paYcabARatvAttaTAtvam । yadvA, vizamaH atyugra asahya ityarTaH AyuDo yasya .) kAmadevaH । iti halAyuDaH ॥
v: pu॰ vizamARi ayugmAni paYca AyuDAni vARA yasya । paYcaSare kAme halA॰ vizamezvAdato'pyatra ।
m: वि-ष˚मायुध m. ‘five-arrowed’, N. of the god of love, Siṃhās.
वि-षमी (ई), f. N. of various works.
विषमी in comp. for वि-षम,
विषमी—भाव m. derangement of equilibrium, MBh.
विषमी—√ भू P. -भवति, to become uneven or irregular, Śak.
a: विषमीभू — {c1c} P. 1 To become uneven. --2 To stumble, fall unevenly; Ś. 4. 15.

m: विषमी—√ कृ P. -करोति, to make uneven, MBh.; to make unequal or crooked, Śiś., Sch.; to make hostile, BhP.

s: tri, (vizama + “gahAdiByaSca .” 4 । 2 । 138 । iti CaH .) vizamAdAgatam । iti sidDAnta kOmudI ॥
m: विषमीय mfn. connected with or produced by unevenness or inequality, uneven, unequal g. गहादि.

s: tri, asamAnam । yaTA, manuH । “BrAtFRAmaviBaktAnAM yadyutTAnaM Bavet saha । na tatra BAgaM vizamaM pitA dadyAt kaTaYcana ॥” iti dAyatattvam ॥ (saNkawaH । yaTA, gItAyAm । 2 । 2 । “kutastvA kaSmalamidaM vizame samupasTitam ॥” anatikramaRIyaH । yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe । 10 । “kA vizamA dEvagatiH kiM durgrAhyaM janaH Kalo loke ॥”)

klI, padyasya triviDavfttAntargatavfttaviSezaH ॥ yaTA, -- “padyaM catuzpadI tacca vfttaM jAtiriti dbiDA । vfttamakzarasaMKyAtaM jAtirmAtrAkftA Bavet ॥ samamardDasamaM vfttaM vizamaYceti tattriDA । samaM samacatuzpAdaM BavatyardDasamaM punaH ॥ AdistftIyavadyasya pAdastUryyo dvitIyavat । BinnacihnacatuzpAdaM vizamaM parikIrttitam ॥” iti CandomaYjaryyAM praTamastavakaH ॥ vargamUloktordDvareKA । yaTA, -- “tyaktvAntyAdbizamAt kftiM dviguRayenmUlaM same tadDfte tyaktvA labDakftintadAdyavizamAllabDaM dviniGnaM nyaset । paNktyAM paNktihfte same'nyavizamAt tyaktvAptavargaM PalaM paNktyAntaddviguRaM nyasediti muhuH paNkterdalaM syAt padam ॥” iti lIlAvatI ॥ (arTAlaNkAraviSezaH । yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe । 10 । “yadvArabDasya vEkalyaM anarTasya ca samBavaH । virUpayoH saNGawanA yA ca tadvizamaM matam ॥” udAharaRam । “kva vanaM taruvalkaBUzaRaM nfpalakzmIH kva mahendravanditA ॥”)

puM, ayugmarASiH । sa tu mezaH miTunaH siMhaH tulA DanuH kumBaSca । yaTA, -- “krUro'Ta sOmyaH puruzo'NganA ca ojo'Ta yugmaM vizamaH samaSca । carasTiradvyAtmakanAmaDeyA mezAdayo'mI kramaSaH pradizwAH ॥” iti jyotistattvam ॥ tAlaviSezaH । yaTA, saNgItadAmodare । “caturvviDaH parijYeyastAlaH kaNkaRanAmakaH । pUrRaH KaRqaH samaScEva vizamaScEva kaTyate ॥ lacatuzkaM gaRO pUrRe KaRqe bindudvayaM guruH । yagaRastu same jYeyastagaRo vizame Bavet ॥” (jaWarAgniviSezaH । yaTA, -- “mandastIkzRo'Ta vizamaH samaSceti caturviDaH । vizamo vAtajAn rogAn tIkzRaH pittanimittajAn ॥” iti vEdyakarugviniScaye mandAgnyaDikAre ॥)
v: tri॰ vigato virudDo vA samaH । 1 asame 2 ayugme (viyoqa) 3 unnatAnate 4 dAruRe 5 saNkawe ca “BinnacihnacatuzpAdaM vizamaM parikIrttitam” ityukte 6 padyaBede na॰ । “ojoTa yugmaM vizamaH samaSca” jyo॰ ta॰ ukte 7 mezamiTunAdyasamarASO pu॰ । 8 tAlaBede pu॰ “caturviDaH parijYeyastAlaH kaNkaRanAmakaH । pUrRaH 1 KaRqaH 2 sama 3 ScEva vizama 4 ScEva kaTyate । nacatuzkaM galO pUrRe 1 KaRqe 2 vindudvayaM guruH । yagaRastu same jYeyastamayawgaRo vizame Bavet” saNgIta॰ । vizamAdAgataH vizamaya, rUpyap, vizamarUpya Ca, vizamIya vizamAdAyate tri॰ si॰ kO॰ ।
m: वि—षम , see s.v.
वि-षम mf(आ)n. (fr. वि + सम) uneven, rugged, rough, MBh.; Hariv.; Kāv. &c.
unequal, irregular, dissimilar, different, inconstant, Br.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Mn. &c.
odd, not even (in numbers &c.), Var.; Kāvyād.
that which cannot be equally divided (as a living sheep among three or four persons), Mn. ix, 119
hard to traverse, difficult, inconvenient, painful, dangerous, adverse, vexatious, disagreeable, terrible, bad, wicked (ibc. ‘terribly’, Śiś.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
hard to be understood, Gol.; Kāv.
unsuitable, wrong, Suśr.; Sarvad.
unfair, dishonest, partial, Mn.; MBh.
rough, coarse, rude, cross, MW.
odd, unusual, unequalled, W.
वि-षम m. a kind of measure, Saṃgīt.
N. of Viṣṇu, MW.
वि-षम n. unevenness, uneven or rough ground or place (सम-विषमेषु, ‘on even and uneven ground’, Śiś.), bad road, VS.; TS.; ŚBr. &c.
oddness (of numbers), W.
a pit, precipice, Mn.; MBh. &c.
difficulty, distress, misfortune, MBh.; R. &c.
वि-षम n. unevenness, inequality (˚मेण ind. ‘unequally’), Kāś.
वि-षम n. (in rhet.) incongruity, incompatibility, Kāvyād.; Pratāp.; Kuval.
pl. (with भरद्-वाजस्य), N. of Sāmans, SV.; ĀrṣBr.
a: विषम — a. [विगतो विरुद्धो वा समः] 1 Uneven, rough, rugged; पथिषु विषमेष्वप्यचलता Mu. 3. 3; व्यालाकीर्णाः सुविषमाः Pt. 1. 64; Me. 19. --2 Irregular, unequal; Māl. 9. 43. --3 Odd, not even. --4 Difficult, hard to understand, mysterious; Ki. 2. 3; विषमाः कर्मगतयः Pt. 4. 50. --5 Impassable, inaccessible; Ki. 2. 3, Bh. 3. 5. --6 Coarse, rough. --7 Oblique; Māl. 4. 2. --8 Painful, troublesome; कांताविश्लेषदुःखव्यतिकरविषमे यौवने विप्रयोगः Bh. 3. 106; H. 4. 3. --9 Very strong, vehement; Māl. 3. 9. --10 Dangerous, fearful; Mv. 5. 56, Mk. 8. 1, 27, Mu. 1. 18, 2. 20. --11 Bad, adverse, unfavourable; Pt. 4. 16. --12 Odd, unusual, unparalleled. --13 Dishonest, artful. --14 Intermittent, (as fever). --15 Wicked. --16 Different. --मः N. of Viṣṇu. --मं 1 Unevenness. --2 Oddness. --3 An inaccessible place, precipice, pit &c. --4 A difficult or dangerous position, difficulty, misfortune; सुप्तं प्रमत्तं विषमस्थितं वा रक्षंति पुण्यानि पुरा कृतानि Bh. 2. 97; Bg. 2. 2. --5 Rough or uneven ground. --6 N. of a figure of speech in which some unusual or incompatible relation between cause and effect is described; (said to be of four kinds; see K. P. Kārikās 126 and 127). --7 A kind of stanza or verse; भिन्नचिह्न चतुष्पादं विषमं परिकीर्तितम्. --मं ind. Unequally, unevenly, unfairly, dangerously &c. --Comp. --अक्षः, --ईक्षणः, --नयनः, --नेत्रः, --लोचनः epithets of Śiva. --अन्नं unusual or irregular food. --अवतारः descent on uneven ground, perhaps also ‘undertaking or embarking in an adventure’; V. 1. --आयुधः, --इषुः, --शरः epithets of the god of love. --कर्णः {1} a quadrangle or tetragon with unequal diagonals. {2} the hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle. --कर्मन् (in math.) the finding of two quantities when the difference of their squares is given and either the sum or the difference of the quantities (Colebrooke.) --कालः an unfavourable season. --चतुरस्रःचतुर्भुजः an unequal quadrilateral figure. --छदः the tree सप्तपर्ण q. v. --छाया the shadow of the gnomon at noon. --ज्वरः remittent fever. --त्रिभुजः a scalene triangle. --लक्ष्मी f. ill-luck. --विभागः unequal distribution (of property). --शील a. cross-tempered, peevish, perverse. --स्थ a. {1} being in an inaccessible position. {2} being in difficulty or misfortune.

s: puM, (vizamaH jvaraH .) jvararogabiSezaH । tasya nidAnakaTanapUrvvikAM saMprAptimAha । “dozo'lpo'hitasamBUto jvarotsfzwasya vA punaH । DAtumanyatamaM prApya karoti vizamajvaram ॥” ayamarTaH । jvarotsfzwasya jvareRa tyaktasya । sannikfzwaM lakzaRamAha । dozaH alpaH jvaramuktyA svalpo'pi । viprakfzwaM hetumAha । ahitamAhAravihArAdi tena samBUtaH saMpUrRo jAtaH anyatamaM DAtuM rasaraktAdikaM prApya dUzayitvA punaH vizamajvaraM karoti । jvarotsfzwasya veti vASabdeneti boDyate । praTamato'pi vizamajvaro Bavati । yata uktam । AramBAdvizamo yastvityAdikam । DAtuM dUzayitvA kaM vizamajvaraM karotItyapekzAyAmAha । “santataM rasaraktasTaH satataM raktaDAtugaH । dozaH krudDo jvaraM puMsAM so'nyedyuH piSitASritaH ॥ medogatastftIye'hni asTimajjagataH punaH । kuryyAccAturTakaM GoramantakaM rogasaNkaram ॥” antakaM antakamiva mArakatvAt ॥ * ॥ vizamajvarasya sAmAnyalakzaRamAha । “yaH syAdaniyatAt kAlAcCItozRAByAM taTEva ca । vegataScApi vizamo jvaraH sa vizamaH smftaH ॥” yastvaniyatAt kAlAt syAdityasyAyamarTaH । yaTA, vAtiko jvaraH saptadinAni pEttiko daSa dinAni SlEzmiko dvAdaSa dinAni dozARAM prAbalye vAtikaScaturddaSa dinAni pEttiko viMSatidinAni SlEzmikaScaturvviMSatidinAni syAt taTA vizAmajvaro niyataM kAlaM vyApya na syAdityarTaH । SItozRAByAM guRAByAM syAt । “vegataScApi vizamaH kadAcidapi vegavAn ॥” kadAcidapi SAntavegaH ॥ vizamajvarasya BedAnAha । “santataH satato'nyedyustftIyakacaturTakO .” tatra santatasya lakzaRamAha । “saptAhaM vA daSAhaM vA dbAdaSAhamaTApi vA । santatyA yo'visargI syAt santataH sa nigadyate ॥” vikalpo vAtikAdiBedAt । santatyA nErantarvyeRa avisargI aparityAgI ॥ nanu muktAnubanDitvaM vizamatvamiti vizamalakzaRaM tadatra na Gawata iti kaTamayaM vizamezu pawyate । Gawata eva iti na dozaH । yata uktaM carakeRa । “visargaM dvAdaSe kftvA divase'vyaktalakzaRam । durllaBopaSamaH kAlaM dIrGamapyanuvarttate ॥” yattu KaranAdaH । “jvarAH paYca ca ye proktAH pUrvvaM satatakAdayaH । catvAraH santataM hitvA jYeyAste vizamajvarAH ॥” iti । taccireRa tyAgABiprAyeRa ॥ * ॥ satatalakzaRamAha । “ahorAtre satatako dbO kAlAvanuvarttate .” dvO kAlO ahanyekakAlaM rAtrAvekakAlam । yato dozARAmahorAtre pratyekaM dvO dvO prakopakAlO । yata uktaM vAgBawena । “vayo'horAtriBuktAnAmantamaDyAdikAH kramAt .” iti ॥ anyedyuzkalakzaRamAha । “anyedyuzkastvahorAtrAdekakAlaM pravarttate .” ekakAlaM dozApekzayA ekakAlamapi dvitIyaM praTamakAle hfdyeva dozasTiteH ॥ * ॥ tftIyakacaturTakayorlakzaRamAha । “tftIyakastftIye'hni caturTe'hni caturTakaH ॥” tftIye'hni ityAgamanadinaM gfhItvA । yata uktam । “dinamekamatikramya yo Bavet sa tftIyakaH । dinadvayaM tvatikramya yaH syAt sa hi caturTakaH ॥” iti ॥ atrAha vfdDasuSrutaH । “kaPasTAnaviBAgena yaTAsaMKyaM karoti hi । satatAnyedyuzkatryAKyacaturTakapralepakAn ॥ ahorAtrAdahorAtrAt sTAnAt sTAnaM prapadyate । doza AmASayaM prApya karoti vizamajvaram ॥” ayamarTaH । AmASayoraH kaRWaSiraHsanDayaH paYca kaPasTAnAni ezu tizWan dozo yaTAsaMKyaM satatAdIn karoti । tatrAmASaye sTito dozaH satataM karoti dvO kAlO ahorAtre kAladbaye dozaprakopAt । hfdaye sTito doza AmASayamAgatya anyedyuzkaM karoti । ekakAlaM nEkadyAdekasminnevAhorAtre doza AmASayamAyAti । tatra dvO dozakopakAlO ekasmin kAle hfdaye tizWatyaparasminnAmASaya iti । kaRWe sTito dozo'horAtrAt hfdayamAyAti । tftIye dine AmASayamAgatya svaprakopakAle tftIyakaM jvaraM karoti ekakAlaM na tu dvO kAlO svaBAvAt । evaM SiraHsTito dozo'horAtrAt kaRWamAyAti । tataH punarahorAtrA dDfdayamAyAti caturTadine AmASayamAgatya svaprakopakAle caturTakaM jvaraM karoti । ekakAlaM na tu dvO kAlO svaBAvAdeva ॥ * ॥ nanu dozasyAgamanakrameRa nijasTAnagamanakramAt kaTaM tftIyacaturTadivasayorjvarAgamanam । ucyate । dozo hi prakopaSamaye vegavattayA lAGavAt svasTAnantu vegadina eva yAti । yata Aha । “dozaH prakopakAle hi vegavattvena lAGavAt । vegavAsara evAyaM svasTAnamaBigacCati ॥” sanDizu sTitaH pralepaM karoti । sanDayaScAmASaye'pi santi tezu sTitaH pralepakaM sarvvadA karoti ॥ * ॥ “nivfttaH punarAyAti vizamo niyate dine । svaBAvaM kAraRaM tatra manyante munipuNgavAH ॥” svaBAvasya kAraRatve kaPasTAnaviBAganirapekzAScaturTakAdiviparyyayA api jvarAH svasya kAle Bavanti । “aDiSete yaTA BUmiM vIjaM kAle prarohati । aDiSete taTA DAtUndozaH kAle prakupyati ॥” suSruto'pyAha । “sa cApi vizamo dehaM na kadAcit pramuYcati । glAnigOravakArSyeByaH sa yasmAnna pramucyate ॥ vege tu samatikrAnte gato'yamiti lakzyate । DAtvantarasTo lInatvAt sOkzmAnnEvopalaByate ॥” dvidozostvaRasya tftIyakasya lakzaRamAha । “kaPapittAttrikagrAhI pfzWAdvAtakaPAtmakaH । vAtapittAcCirogrAhI triviDaH syAttftIyakaH ॥” trikagrAhI vedanayA trikaM gfhRAti ityarTaH ॥ * ॥ nanu kaPapittAttrikagrAhI vedanayA trikavyApI trikasya vAtasTAnaM tatkayaM tadgfhItO pittakaPO anyasTAnagatvena durbbalatvena durbbalO vegaM kurute । ucyate dozARAM sTAnaniyamaH na tu kupitAnAm । taTA ca suSrutaH । “kupitAnAM hi dozARAM SarIre pariDAvati । yatra saNgaH sa vEguRyAdbyADistatropajAyate ॥” evaM anyasTAnagatvena caturTako'pi vAcyam । vAtakaPAtmakaH pfzWAt vyaTayA pfzWaM vyApya Bavati ityarTaH । yavlopakarmmaRyaDikaraRe ceti sUtreRa paYcamI ॥ * ॥ kaPolvaRasya vAtolvaRasya ca caturTakasya lakzaRamAha । “caturTako darSayati svaBAvaM dbiviDaM jvaraH । jaNGAByAM SlEzmikaH pUrvvaM Siraso'nilasaMBavaH ॥” SlEzmikaH SlezmolvaRaH taTA anilasaMBavaH vAtolvaRaH । santatAdInAM tridozajatvAt । uktaYca carakeRa । “prAyaSaH sannipAtena paYca syurvvizamajvarAH .” iti । prAyaSo grahaRAdekadozajAH dvidozajA api na Bavanti iti jEjjawaH ॥ pUrvvaM praTamaM jaNGAByAM vyaTayA jaNGe vyApya paScAt sakalaM SarIraM vyApnoti । evamulvaRavAtajAtaH SirasaH pUrvvaM vyaTayA Siro vyApya sakalaM SarIraM vyApnotItyarTaH । “vizamajvara evAnyaScaturTakaviparyyayaH । asTimajjagato dozaScaturTakaviparyyayaH ॥” anyaH santatAdipaYcakAdaparaScaturTakaviparyyayAKyo jvaraH so'pi vizamajvara eva । sa kiMDAtusTa ityapekzAyAmAha asTItyAdi । tasya caturTakaviparyyayasya lakzaRamAha । “sa maDye jvarayatyahnIAdyante ca vimuYcati ॥” caturTakaviparyyaya ityupalakzaRam । satatAdiviparyyayo'pi bodDavyaH । yaTA, ahorAtre dvO kAlO muYcati SezaM sarvvamahorAtraM tizWatIti satataviparyyayaH । ahorAtre ekaM kAlaM muYcati SezaM sarvvamahorAtraM tizWati ityanyedyuzkaviparyyayaH । maDye ekaM dinaM jvarayati AdAvante ca dine muYcati iti tftIyakaviparyyayaH । ete vizamajvarA upalakzakAH anye rAtrijvarAdayo'pi vizamajvarA bodDavyAH ॥ yaTA, -- “samO vAtakaPO yasya kzIRapittasya dehinaH । rAtrO prAyo jvarastasya divA hInakaPasyatu ॥” prAyo bAhulyena ॥ * ॥ santatAdInAM SItapUrvvatve dAhapUrvvatve ca hetumAha । “tvaksTO SlezmAnilO SItamAdO janayato jvaram । tayoH praSAntayoH pittamantardAhaM karoti ca ॥” SItaM SItasahitaM praSAntayoH praSAntavegayoH । antaH aByantare । “karotyAdO taTA pittaM tvaksTaM dAhamatIva ca । tasmin praSAnte tvitarO kurutaH SItamantataH ॥” antataH hastapAdAditaH ॥ * ॥ SItAdidAhAdijvarayostridozajatvamAha । “dvAvetO dAhaSItAdI jvarO saMsargajO smftO । dAhapUrvvastayoH kazwaH suKasADyatamo'paraH ॥” saMsargajO sAnnipAtikO । kazwaH kazwasADyaH ॥ * ॥ vizamajvaraviSezAnAha । “vidagDe'nnarase dehe Slezmapitte vyavasTite । tenArdDaM SItalaM dehaM cArdDamuzRaM prajAyate ॥” annarase vidagDe AhAraje rase duzwe Slezmapitte ca vyavasTite duzwe sTite tena hetunA SItalaM kaPena uzRaM pittena ardDatvaM cArdDanArISvarAkAreRa narasiMhAkAreRa vA । “kAye duzwaM yadA pittaM SlezmA cAnte vyavasTitaH । tenozRatvaM SarIrasya SItatvaM hastapAdayoH ॥” ante hastapAdAdO । “kAye SlezmA yadA duzwaH pittaScAnte vyavasTitaH । SItatvaM tena gAtre syAduzRatvaM hastapAdayoH ॥” vizamajvaraviSezasya pralepakasya lakzaRamAha । “pralimpanniva gAtrARi GarmmeRa gOraveRa ca । mandrajvaravilepI ca saSItaH syAt pralepakaH ॥” gOraveRa upalakzitaH । mandajvaravilepI mandavegasya jvarasya sadA sambanDo'syAstIti mandajvaravilepI ayaM vizamajvaraH । yaTA ca suSrutaH । pralepakAKyo vizamaH prAyaH kleSAya SoziRAmiti ॥ * ॥ aTa vizamajvarARAM sAmAnyacikitsA । “jvarASca vizamAH sarvve sannipAtasamudBavAH । aTolvaRasya dozasya tezu kAryyaM cikitsitam ॥ vizamezvaya karttavyamUrdDvaM vADaSca SoDanam । snigDozwErannapAnESca Samayedvizamajvaram ॥ * ॥ kAliNgakaH pawolasya patraM SamayantyASu paYca paYcaviDajvaram ॥” kAliNgakaH indrayavaH । vatsakaH kuwajaH । candanamatra raktacandanam । kavAyAH paYca । paYcaviDaM santatasatatAnyedyuzkatfyIyacaturTakarUpam ॥ * ॥ ekena divasenEva SItajvaraharaM param । maDyAhnasamaye paTyaM SiKariRI BaktakaM ca ॥” * ॥ SItajvare BUtaBEravacUrRam । “elA jAtIPalaM vyozatriPalAjIrakaM GanaH । saviqaNgaM sitAyuktaM cUrRaM SItajvarApaham ॥ kAyasTAnAkulItiktAvayasTApuracorakEH । sahadevAvacAkuzWEH SItaGnErDapalepanEH ॥ etErevOzaDEH pizwErlavaRakzArasaMyutEH । sAmlErvvipAcitaM tElamaByaNgAcCItanASanam ॥” kAyasTA haritakI । nAkulI rAsnA । BedasAI iti loke । vayasTA guqUcI । puro gugguluH । corakaH । Bawiura । tadalABe gawivana । sahadevA bfhadvalA । kzAro yavakzAraH । kAyasTAdiDUpaM lepanaM tElaYca ॥ “eraRqasya tu patrARi liptaBUmO niDApayet । dAhAdijvariRo dehe tAni patrARi DArayet ॥ tena naSyati dAho'sya jvaraScEvopaSAmyati । dAhe SAnte yadA SEtyaM tacca yuktyA nivArayet ॥ jaGanacakracalanmaRimeKalA sarasacandanacandravilepanA । vanalateva taruM parivezwayet prabaladAhanipIqitamaNganA ॥” candraH karpUraH । “tadaNgasaNgasaMjAtaSEtyErddAhe nivArite । prahlAdaScAsya vijYAya tAM strImapanayet punaH ॥ * ॥ suvarccikAnAgarakuzWamUrvvAlAkzAniSAlohitayazwikABiH । sidDaM haret zaqguRatakrapaNkaM tElaM jvaraM dAhasamanvitaYca ॥” zawtakratElam ॥ * ॥ “rAsnAnAgarakuzWacandananiSAyazwyAhvakfzRAvalA lAkzAsEnDavasArivAmaDurasAdevadrurohItakEH । soSIrAmbuDiPenarOhizajalEstElaM pacet zaqguRe takretacCamayejjvaraM dfQataraM dAhAdiSItAdikam ॥” candanamatra Svetam । maDurasA mUrvvA । rohItakaH rohiRi iti loke । rOhizaM rohisa iti tfRaviSezaH । jalaM bAlakam । mahAzawtakratElam ॥ * ॥ “padmakotpalakahlAramfRAlavizapOzkarEH kumudoSIramaYjizWApadmagErikakawPalEH ॥ sArivAdvayaloDrAbdakzIrIKarjjuramastakEH । DAtrISatAvarIyuktEH kvATe kalke prayojitEH ॥ lAkzArasapayaH SuklamastuBiH saha kAYjikEH । pakvatElamidaM tvacyaM dAhajvaraharaM param ॥” lAkzArasAdiH pfTak tElatulyaH padmakAditElam ॥ * ॥ “pralepake prayuYjIta SlezmajvaraharIM kriyAm । rudrajawA goSfNgaM viqAlavizWoragasya nirmmokaH । madanaPalaBUtakeSyO vaMSatvagrudranirmmAlyam ॥ DftayavamayUracandracCagalakaromARi sarzapAH savacAH । hiNgugavAsTimarIcAH samaBAgASCAgamUtrasaMpizwAH ॥ DUpanaviDinA Samayantyete sarvvAn jvarAnniyatam । grahaqAkinIpiSAcapretavikArAnayaM DUpaH ॥” rudrajawA jawADArI । BUtakeSI jawAmAMsI । rudranirmmAlyaM rudranirmmAlyapuzpAdi । mayUracandraH mayUrapucCacandrakam । mAheSvaro DUpaH ॥ * ॥ “somaM sAnucaraM devaM samAtfgaRamISvaram । pujayan prayataH SIGraM mucyate vizamajvarAt ॥” somaM umAdisahitam । sAnucaraM nandyAdigaRasahitam । prayataH pavitraH ॥ * ॥ “vizRuM sahasramUrdDAnaM carAcarapatiM viBum । stuvannAmasahasreRa jvarAn sarvvAn vyapohati ॥” sahasramUrdDAnamiti sahasraSIrzetyAdi vedABihitam । nAmasahasreRa BAratoktenetyarTaH ॥ * ॥ jvarasyApi devatAtvAt pUjA kAryyA । yata Aha videhaH । “tIrTAyatanadevAgniguruvfdDopasarpaREH । SradDayA pUjanEScApi sahasA SAmyati jvaraH ॥” tIrTaM fzijuzwaM jalam । AyatanaM devADizWitaM puruzottamakzetraSrISElAdi ॥ * ॥ “nimbapatraM varA vyozaM yavAnI lavaRatrayam । kzAro digvahnirAmezutrinetrakramaSo'MSakAH ॥ sarvvamekIkftaM cUrRaM pratyUze BakzayennaraH । ekAhikaM dvyahikaYca taTA tridivasajvaram ॥ cAturTikaM mahAGoraM santataM satataM hi vA । DAtusTaYca tridozotTaM jvaraM hanti ca mAnavam ॥” nimbAdi cUrRam । iti vizamajvarADikAraH ॥ iti BAvaprakASaH ॥
v: pu॰ vizama ugro jvaraH । jvaraBede । yaToktaM BAvapra॰ “tatra vizamajvarasya nidAnakaTanapUrvikAM saMprAptimAha “dozo'lpo'hitasamBUto jvaro sfzwasya vA punaH । DAtumanyatamaM prApya varoti viza॰ jvaram” । ayamarTaH jjvarotasfzwasya jvaraRa tyaktasya । sannikfzwahetumAha । dozaH alpaH, jvaramuktasya svalo'pi । viprakfzwahetumAha । ahitamAhAravihArAdi tena samBUtaH saMpUrRojAtaH anyatamanDAtuM rasaraktAdikam prApya dUzayitvA punarvizamajvaraM karoti jvarotasfzwasya veti vASabdeneti boDyate । praTamato vizamajvaro Bavati yata uktam । “AramBAdvizamo yastu” ityAdikam rasAdikanDAtuM dUzayitvAkaM vi zamajvaraM karoti ityapekzayAmAha “santataM rasaraktasTaH satata raktaDAtugaH । dozaH krudDo jvaraM puMsAM so'nyedyuH piSitASritaH । medogatastftIye'hni asTimajjAgataH punaH । kuryyAccAturTikaM GoramantakaM rogasaNkaram” । antakamiva mArakatvAt । aTa vizamajvarasya sAmAnyaM lakzaRamAha “yaH syAdaniyatAt kAlAt SItozRAByAM taTEva ca । vegataScApi vizamojvaraH sa vizamaH smftaH” । yaH syAdaniyatAt kAlAdityasyAyamarTaH । yaTA vAtikojvaraH sapta dinAni, pEttiko daSa dinAni, SlEzmiko dvAdaSadinAni, dozARAM prAbalyErvAtikaScaturdaSadinAni, pEkiko viMSatadinAni, SlEzmikaScaturviMSatidinAni syAt । taTA vizamajvaro niyataM kAlaM vyApya na syAdityarTaH । SItozRaByAM guRaByAM syAt । “vegataScApi vizamaH kadAcidativegavAn” । kadAcicCAntavegaH । vizamajvarasya BedAnAha “santataH satato'nyedyustftIyaka caturTakO” । tatra santatasya lakzaRamAha “saptAhaM vA daSAhaM vA dvAdaSAhamaTApi vA । santatyA yo'visargI syAt santataH sa nigadyate” । vikalpo vAtikAdiBedAt । santatTA nErantaryyeRa avisagrgI aparityAgo । nanu suktAnubanDitvaM vizamatvamiti vizamalakzaRam । tadatra na Gawata iti kaTamayaM vizamezu paWyate” । Gawata eveti na dozaH । yata uktaM carakeRa “visargaM dvAdaSe kftvA divase vyaktalakzaRam । durlaBopaSamaH kAlaM dIrGamevAnuparttate” iti । yattu KaranAdenoktama “jvarAH paYca tu ye proktAH pUrve santatakAdayaH । catvAraH santataM hitvA jYeyAste vizamajvarAH” iti taccireRa tyAgABiprAyeRa । satatakakzaRamAha “vyahorAtre satatako dvO kAlAvanuvarttate” । dvO kAlO ahanyekakAlaM rAtrAvekakAlam । yato dozAkzAgahorAtne pratyekaM dvO dvO prakopakAlO । yata uktaM vAgmawena “vayo'horAtriBuktAnAmantamaDyAdikAH kramAditi” । anyedyuzkalakzaRamAha । “anyedyuzkastrahorAtrAdekakAlaM pravarttate” । ekakAlaM dozApekzayA ekakAlamapi na dvitIyaM, praTamakAle hfdyeva dAzasTiteH । tftIyakacaturTakayIrlakzaRamAha । “tftIyakastftIye'hni caturTe'hni caturTakaH” । tftIye'hni ityAgamanadinaM gfhItvA yata uktam “dinamekamatikramya yo Bavet sa tftIyakaH । dinadvayantvatikramya yaH syAt sa hi caturTakaH” iti । atrAha vfdDasuSrutaH “kaPasTAnaviBAgena yaTAsaNKyaM karoti hi । satatAnyedyuzkatryAKya caturTakapralepakAn । ahorAtrAdahorAtrAt sTAnAt sTAnaM prapadyata । doza AmASayaM prApya karoti vizamajvaram” । ayamarTaH AmASayoraHkaRWaSiraHsanDayaH paYca kaPasTAnAni ezu tizWan dozo yaTAsaNKyaM saMtatAdIn karoti । tatra AmASaye sTito dozaH satataM karoti dvO kAlO, ahorAtre kAladvaye dozaprakopAt । hfdaye sTito doza AmASayamAgatya anyedyuzkaM karoti ekakAlaM nEkawyAdekasminnevAhorAtre doza AmASayamAgatya anyedyuzkaM karoti । tatra dvO dozaprakopakAlO ekasmin kAle hfdaye tizWatyaparasminnAmASaya iti । kaRWesTito dozo'horAtrAt hfdayamAyAti । tftIye dine AmASayamAgatya svaprakopakAle tftIyakaM jvaraM karoti ekakAlaM na tu dvO kAlO svaBAvAt । evameva SiraHsTito dozaH ahorAtrAt kaRWamAyAti tataH punarahorAtrAt hfdayamAyAti caturTe dine AmASayamAgatya svaprakopakAle caturTakaM jvaraM karoti ekakAlannatu dvO kAlO svaBAvAdeva । nanu dozasyAgamana krameRa nijasTAnagamanakramAt kaTaM tftIyacaturTadivasayorjvarAgamanam । ucyate । dozo hi prakopasamaye vegavattayA lAGavAt svasTAnantu vegadina eva yAti । yata Aha “dozaH prakopakAle hi vegavattvena lAGavAt । vegavAsara evAyaM svasTAnamaDigacCati” । sanDizu sTitaH pralepakaM karoti । sanDayaScAmASaye'pi santi tezu sTitaH pralepakaM sarvadA karoti “nivfttaH punarAyAti vizamo niyate dine । svamAvaH kAraRaM tatra manTanve munipuNgavAH” । svaBAvasya kAraRatve kaPasvAnaviBAganirapekzAScaturTakAdiviparyyayA api jvarAH svasvakAle praBavanti aDiSete yaTA mUmiM vIjaM kAle prarohati । aDiSete taTA DAtUn dozaH kAle prakupyati” । suSruto'pyAha “sa cApi vizamaM dehaM na kadAcit pramuYcati । glanigOravakArSyeByaH sa yasmAnna pramucyate । yege tu samatikrAnte gato'yamiti lakzyate । DAtvantarezu lonatvAt sOkzmyAnnEvopalaByate” । dvidozolvaRasya tftIyakasya lakzaRamAha “kaPapittAt trikagrAhI pfzWAdvAtakaPAtmakaH । vAtapittAcCirogrAhI triviDaH syAt tftIyakaH” । trikagrAhI vedanayA trikaM gfhRAtItyarTaH । nanu kaPapittAt trikagrAhI vedanayA trikavyApI trikaM tu vAtasTAnaM tatkaTaM tadgfhRItaH pittakaPO anyasTAnagatvena durbalatvAt durbalO ca kaTaM vegaM kurutaH, dozARAM sTAnaniyamaH na tu kupitAnAM taTA ca sUSrutaH “kupitAnAM hi dozARAM SarIre pariDAyati । yatra saNgaH sa vEguRyAt vyADistatropajAyate” । evamanyasTAnagatvena caturTako vAcyaH । vAtakaPAtmakaH pfzWAt vyaTayA pfzWaM vyApya BavatItyarTaH । “lyavlope karmaRyaDikaraRe ca” pA॰ sUtreRa paYcamI । kaPolvaRasya vAtolvaRasya caturTakasyalakzaRamAha “caturTakA darSayati svaBAvaM dviviDaM jvaraH । jaNGAByAM SlEzmikaH pUrvaM Siraso'nilasamBavaH । maDyakAyantu gfhRAti pUrvaM yastu sa pittajaH । vizamajvara evAnyaScaturTakaviparyyayaH” । SlEzmikaH SlezmolvaRaH । taTA anilasamBavo vAtolvaRaH santatAdInAM tridozajatvam । yata uktaM carake “prAyaSaH sannipAtena paYca syurvizamajvarAH” iti । prAyaSograhaRAde kadozajA dvidozajA api BavantIti jEjjawaH । pUrvaM praTamaM jaNGAByAm vyaTayA jaNGe vyApya paScAt sakalaM SarIraM vyApnoti । evamulvaKavAtajAtaH SiraRaH pUrvaM vyaTayA SirovyApya sakalaM SarIraM vyApnonItyarTaH । “vizamajvara evAnTaScAturTakaviparyyayaH । asTimajjagato dozaScAtarTakaviparyyayaH । jAyate BizajA jYeyo vizamajvara eva saH” । anTaH santatAdipaYcakAdaparaH cAturTakaviparTyayAKyo jvaraH so'pi vizamajvara eva vEdyena jYAtavyaH । sa kiM DAtusTa ityapekzayAmAha asTItyAdi । tasya cAturTakaviparyyayasya lakzaRamAha “sa maDye jvarayatyahnI Adyante ca vimucati” । caturTakaviparyyayaH ityupalakzaRam  santatAdiviparyyayo'pi bodDavyaH । yaTA ahorAtre dvO kAlO sutati SezaM sarvamahorAtraM tizWatIti satataviparyyayaH । ahorAtre ekaKAlaM muYcati SezaM sarvamahorAtraM tizWati anyedyuzkaviparyyayaH maDye ekaM dinaM jvarayati A dAva nte ca muYcatIti tftIyakaviparyyayaH । ete vizamajvaropalakzakAH anye rAtrijvarAdayo'pi vizamajvarA bodDavyAH yaTA “samO vAtakaPo yasya kzoRapittasya dehinaH । rAtrO prAyo jvarastasya divA hInakaPasya tu” । prAyaH bAhulyena । santatAdInAM SItapUrvatve dAhapUrvatve ca hetumAha “tvaksTO SlezmAnilO SItamAdO janayato jvaram । tayoH praSAntayoH pittamantardAhaM karoti caM । SItaM SItasahitam । praSAntayoH praSAntavegayoH antaH aByantare । “karotyAdO taTA pittaM tvaksTaM dAhamatIva ca । tasmin praSAnte tvitarO kurutaH SItamantataH” । antataH hastapAdAditaH । SItAdidAhAdijvarayoH tridozajatvamAha “dvAvetO dAhaSItAdijvarO saMsargajo smftO । dAhapUrvastayoH kazwaH suKasADyatamo'paraH” । saMsargajO mAnnipAtikO । kazwaH kazwasADyaH । vizamajvaraviSezamAha “vidagDe'nnarase dehe Slezmapitte vyavasTite । tenArdDaM SItalaM dehamUrdDamuzRaM prajAyate” । annarase vidagDe AhAraje rase duzwe, dehe Slezmapitte vyavasTite duzwe sTite । tena hetunA SItalaM kaPena uzRaM pittena, ardDatvaM cArdDanArISvarAkAreRa narasiMhA kAreRa vA । “kAye duzwaM yadA pittaM SlezmA cAnte vyavasTitaH । tenozRatvaM SarIrasva SItatTaM hastapAdayoH” । ante hatapAdAdO “kAye SlezmA yadA duzwaH pitta cAnte vyavasTitam । SItatvaM tena gAtre syAduzRatvaM hastapAdayoH” । vizamajvaraviSezasya pralepakasya lakzaRamAha “pralipanniva gAtrARi GarmeRa gOraveRa ca । mandajvaravilepI ca sa SIMtaH syAt pralepakaH” । goraveRa upalakzitaH । mandajvaravilepI mandavegasya vilepaH sadA sambanDo'syAstIti mandajvarapilepI । aTaM vizamajvaraH । taTA ca suSrutaH “pralepasAKyo vizamaH prAyaSaH kleSaSoziRAm । jvarASca vizamAH sarve prAyaH kleSAya SoziRAm” ।

special sphere or department, peculiar province or field of action, peculiar element, concern (ifc. = ‘concerned with, belonging to, intently engaged on’; विषये, with gen. or ifc. = ‘in the sphere of, with regard or reference to’; अत्र विषये, ‘with regard to this object’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
space or room (sometimes = fitness) for (gen.), Kāv.; Pañcat.

an object of sense (these are five in number, the five इन्द्रिय, or organs of sense having each their proper विषय or object, viz. 1. शब्द, ‘sound’, for the ear, cf. श्रुति-विषय; 2. स्पर्श, ‘tangibility’, for the skin; 3. रूप, ‘form’ or ‘colour’, for the eye; 4. रस, ‘savour’, for the tongue; 5. गन्ध, ‘odour’ for the nose: and these five Viṣayas are sometimes called the Guṇas or ‘properties’ of the five elements, ether, air, fire, water, earth, respectively; cf. श्रुति-विषय-गुण), Yājñ.; Śaṃk.; Sarvad.; IW. 83
a symbolical N. of the number ‘five’, VarBṛS.

anything perceptible by the senses, any object of affection or concern or attention, any special worldly object or aim or matter or business, (pl.) sensual enjoyments, sensuality, KaṭhUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
any subject or topic, subject matter, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
an object (as opp. to ‘a subject’), Sarvad.
a fit or suitable object (‘for’ dat. gen., or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.

(in phil.) the subject of an argument, category, general head (one of the 5 members of an Adhikaraṇa [q.v.], the other 4 being विशय or संशय, पूर्व-पक्ष, उत्तर-पक्ष or सिद्धान्त, and संगति or निर्णय), Sarvad.
inorganic matter, IW. 73
(in gram.) limited or restricted sphere (e.g. छन्दसि विषये, ‘only in the Veda’), Kāś. (ifc. = restricted or exclusively belonging to)
(in rhet.) the subject of a comparison (e.g. in the comp. ‘lotus-eye’ the second member is the विषय, and the first the विषयिन्), Kuval.; Pratāp.
a country with more than 100 villages, L.
a refuge, asylum, W.
a religious obligation or observance, ib.
a lover, husband, ib.
semen virile, ib.
a: विषयः — 1 An object of sense; (these are five, corresponding to the five organs of sense; रूप, रस, गंध, स्पर्श and शब्द corresponding to the eye, tongue, nose, skin, and ear); श्रुतिविषयगुणा या स्थिता व्याप्य विश्वं Ś. 1. 1. --2 A worldly object or concern, an affair, a transaction. --3 The pleasures of sense, worldly or sensual objects (usually in pl.) यौवने विषयैषिणां R. 1. 8; शब्दादीन् विषयान्भोक्तुं 10. 25; विषयव्यावृत्तकौतूहलः V. 1. 9; निर्विष्टविषयस्नेहः 12. 1, 3. 70, 8. 10, 19. 49; Bg. 2. 59. --4 An object, a thing, matter; नार्यो न जग्मुर्विषयांतराणि R. 7. 12, 8. 89. --5 An object or thing aimed at, mark, object; भूयिष्ठमन्यविषया न तु दृष्टिरस्याः Ś. 1. 31; Śi. 9. 40. --6 Scope, range, reach, compass; सौमित्रेरपि पत्रिणामविषये तत्र प्रिये क्वासि भोः U. 3. 45; यस्मिन्नीश्वर इत्यनन्यविषयः शब्दो यथार्थाक्षरः V. 1. 1; सकलवचनानामविषयः Māl. 1. 30, 36; U. 5. 19; Ku. 6. 17. --7 Department, sphere, province, field, element; सर्वत्रौदरिकस्याभ्यवहार्यमेव विषयः V. 3. --8 A subject, subject matter, topic; अयि मलयज महिमायं कस्य गिरामस्तु विषयस्ते Bv. 1. 11; so शृंगारविषयको ग्रंथः ‘treating of love’. --9 The topic or subject to be explained, general head; the first of the five members of an Adhikaraṇa q. v. --10 A place, spot; परिसरविषयेषु लीढमुक्ताः Ki. 5. 38. --11 A country, realm, domain, territory, district, kingdom; Pt. 2. 2. --12 A refuge, an asylum. --13 A collection of villages. --14 A lover, husband. --15 Semen virile. --16 A religious observance. --17 A symbolical expression for the number ‘five.’ (विषये means ‘with regard or reference to,’ ‘in respect of’, ‘in the case of’, ‘regarding’, ‘cancerning’; या तत्रास्ते युवतिविषये सृष्टिराद्येव धातुः Me. 82; स्त्रीणा विषये; धनविषये &c.). --Comp. --अभिरतिः {1} attachment to objects of sense or worldly pleasures; Ki. 6. 44; so ˚अभिलाषः Ki. 3. 13. --आत्मक a. {1} consisting of worldly objects. {2} carnal, sensual. --आसक्त, --निरत a. addicted to sensual objects, sensualist, worldly-minded. --आसक्तिः --उपसेवा, --निरतिः f. --प्रसंगः addiction to pleasures of sense, sensuality. --एषिन् a. addicted to worldly objects; R. 1. 8. --ग्रामः the collection of the objects of sense. --सुखं the pleasures of sense.

विषुवन्—मण्डल n. the equator, Sūryas.

top, summit, vertex, AV.

(Nom. sing. m. विष्वङ्; f. विषूची, n. विष्वक्) 1 Going or being everywhere, all-pervading; विष्वङ्मोहः स्थगयति कथं मंदभाग्यः करोमि U. 3. 38, Māl. 9. 20. --2 Separating into parts. --3 Different. --4 Alternately. m: वि-ष्टर m. (√ स्तृ) anything spread out, a handful of rushes or grass for sitting on (esp. the seat of the presiding Brāhman at a sacrifice), GṛŚrS.; MBh.

a tree, L.
N. of a divine being reckoned among the Viśve Devāḥ, Hariv.

a: विष्टरः — 1 A seat (a stool, chair &c.); R. 8. 18. --2 A layer, bed (as of Kuśa grass.). --3 A handful of Kuśa grass. --4 The seat of the presiding priest (or Brahman) at a sacrifice. --5 A tree. --Comp. --भाज् a. seated on or occupying a seat; Ku. 7. 72. --श्रवस् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; Śi. 14. 12.
